title: Mealie
descript: Mealie is a self-hosted recipe manager. Paste the address of a recipe page and Mealie imports the ingredients and steps into your own cookbook; from there you plan the week's meals, build a shopping list from the recipes you chose, and share everything with your household. This app runs the official Docker Hub image as a non-root container on your NAS and keeps recipes, photos, users and the database in the application data folder, so nothing is lost on restart or update.
release_note: 1. First release: Mealie 3.28.0 from Docker Hub, running as a non-root container. Recipes, photos and the database live in the application data folder and survive restarts and updates.
important: Requires DockerEngine (installed if missing); add a registry mirror if Docker Hub is unreachable. Open http://<NAS-IP>:8010/. First login: changeme@example.com with password MyPassword - change the e-mail and the password in the user settings right away. Everything is kept in DockerAppData/mealiedocker; keep data/.secret and data/.session_secret, they are needed for saved integrations and login sessions. Back up the data folder before uninstalling with data removal.
data_notes: Everything Mealie stores lives in one directory: `mealie.db` (the SQLite database with recipes, users, meal plans and shopping lists), `recipes/` (uploaded and scraped images), `backups/` (automatic backups Mealie creates itself), `mealie.log` and the two key files `.secret` and `.session_secret` that protect saved integrations and login sessions.
design_notes: **Runs as the non-root application user.** The upstream start script only switches to a dedicated user when it is started as root; with `user: "1000:1000"` Mealie serves directly, verified on real hardware.
**Fixed image tag, never `:latest`**, Docker Hub only, no `privileged`, no `network_mode: host`, no Docker socket.
**Health check** probing `/api/app/about` on container port 9000, the same endpoint the upstream image uses.
**One data directory.** The whole application state is `/app/data`, mounted from the application data folder, so copying that folder is a complete backup.
limitations: The first login uses the built-in administrator `changeme@example.com` with the password `MyPassword`. Change the e-mail address and the password immediately, otherwise anyone on your network can sign in.
Recipe import depends on the source website. Pages that block automated access or hide their content behind a login cannot be imported automatically; Mealie lets you enter those recipes by hand.
The app is served over plain HTTP on the LAN. Do not expose the published port to the internet without TLS.

zh-cn.descript: Mealie 是自托管的菜谱管理器。把菜谱网页地址粘进去，Mealie 就会自动抓取食材与步骤存进你自己的菜谱库；之后可以安排每周菜单、按选中的菜谱生成购物清单，并与家人共享。本应用在 NAS 上以非 root 容器运行 Docker Hub 官方镜像，菜谱、图片、用户与数据库都保存在应用数据目录中，重启与更新都不会丢失。
zh-cn.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺失时应用中心会自动提示安装）；若 NAS 无法直连 Docker Hub，请先配置镜像加速。安装后打开 http://<NAS-IP>:8010/。首次登录使用内置管理员 changeme@example.com，密码 MyPassword，请立即在用户设置里修改邮箱与密码。所有数据都在 DockerAppData/mealiedocker 目录；data/.secret 与 data/.session_secret 请务必保留，否则已保存的集成密钥与会话将无法恢复。卸载并删除数据前请先备份应用数据目录。
zh-cn.release_note: 1. 首次发布：来自 Docker Hub 的 Mealie 3.28.0，以非 root 容器运行。菜谱、图片与数据库保存在应用数据目录，重启与更新都不会丢失。

zh-hk.descript: Mealie 是自架式食譜管理器。把食譜網頁位址貼進去，Mealie 就會自動抓取材料與步驟存進你自己的食譜庫；之後可以安排每週菜單、依選中的食譜產生購物清單，並與家人共享。本應用在 NAS 上以非 root 容器執行 Docker Hub 官方映像，食譜、圖片、使用者與資料庫都保存在應用資料目錄中，重新啟動與更新都不會遺失。
zh-hk.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺少時應用中心會自動提示安裝）；若 NAS 無法直連 Docker Hub，請先設定映像加速。安裝後開啟 http://<NAS-IP>:8010/。首次登入使用內建管理員 changeme@example.com，密碼 MyPassword，請立即在使用者設定中修改電郵與密碼。所有資料都在 DockerAppData/mealiedocker 目錄；data/.secret 與 data/.session_secret 請務必保留，否則已儲存的整合金鑰與工作階段將無法還原。解除安裝並刪除資料前請先備份應用資料目錄。
zh-hk.release_note: 1. 首次發佈：來自 Docker Hub 的 Mealie 3.28.0，以非 root 容器執行。食譜、圖片與資料庫保存在應用資料目錄，重新啟動與更新都不會遺失。
